item.title: AI identifies rare gastrointestinal pathologies without targeted disease training
item.description: Dippel and colleagues assessed AI detection models' ability to identify infrequent pathological changes on gastrointestinal biopsies.

item.title: Alcohol May Increase Osteoarthritis Risk in a Dose-Dependent Manner
item.description: Adults who consume alcohol face an increased risk for incident osteoarthritis, with the risk rising with higher consumption levels.

item.title: Smartphones as retinal cameras offer new opportunities for global eye care
item.description: Smartphones could play an important role in the early detection of eye diseases, including in settings where specialized ophthalmic infrastructure is limited.

item.title: What if emotional immaturity has always been endemic?
item.description: Looking at emotional maturity through an epidemiological lens may unravel the endemic status of emotional immaturity in postmodern humanity.
